# AlertEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An exception condition raised by a device threshold setting, or other metric.

## Scope note

- Includes signal loss, low glucose alert, high glucose alert, low pod insulin, expired pod, etc.

## Broader

- [DiabetesEvent](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
